name: Manastorm Shadowfang Keep: solo Archmage Arugal does not full-heal when his Curse charms the only attacker (#8345)
contract: #8345: in a solo Manastorm run of Shadowfang Keep, Archmage Arugal's Arugal's Curse charms the lone
player (spell 7621). With no other threat left in his list, generic evade logic used to reset him to
full health and drop combat the instant the charm landed, soft-locking a solo-advertised floor. The fix
suppresses that evade for the charm's duration so the fight continues once control returns; it never
changes the curse or the boss.
This scenario proves setup correctness (private run, phase match, combat engaged, Chaotic Link present,
player not pre-charmed), then forces the charm directly with '.cast back 7621 triggered' so Arugal
himself (the selected creature) casts it onto the invoking player, exactly as his own SmartAI In-Combat
timer eventually would, without waiting on that timer. Both '.cast back' and '.cast target' need a
attack_nearby only sends CMSG_ATTACKSWING and never selects. An earlier attempt at a forced cast skipped
that selection, failed with 'select character or creature', and was misread as an RBAC permission gap.
The new select_nearby harness action (apps/coa-gameplay-test) sends the missing selection. '.cast back'
(not '.cast target') is used because it targets the invoking player directly and does not depend on
Creature::GetVictim() already pointing at the player, which made an earlier attempt with '.cast target'
intermittently fail under batch load before the AuraScript's own gate (caster entry, instance, Solo
mode -- see ManastormShadowfangKeepCompat.cpp) ever got a say. The closing assertions confirm the
player is actually charmed and that Arugal neither evaded (his Chaotic Link encounter aura would be
stripped by Unit::RemoveEvadeAuras() on a real evade, and it survives here) nor dropped out of combat.

steps.label: The player entered a private Manastorm instance
Match the native phase 1 Manastorm room so the boss is visible to this lane
Leaving the preparation bubble at the boss clears its safety aura
CONTROL: the player is not charmed before Arugal's Curse is cast
CONTROL: Arugal's Chaotic Link encounter aura is present before the charm
Arugal is engaged and attackable ahead of the charm (setup is otherwise correct)
Select Arugal so '.cast back' can resolve him as the caster
Let a little real combat happen before forcing the cast
The player is charmed by Arugal's Curse
Arugal did not evade: his Chaotic Link encounter aura survives the charm
Arugal did not evade: he is still attackable, not reset out of combat
